a rate, or a range of rates, with a source and a grade

mortality_gap.refusal: no claim in the registry carries a mortality level, rate or range, and none carries a county-resolution mortality or unmet-need series: M006 stays UNIDENTIFIED and the model keeps the rule it has, which is that nobody dies
mortality_gap.what_would_change_it: a sourced series with a level and a range would let a rule be declared and calibrated; until then an arm that removes members would be invention wearing a control's name
